rules.name: Berserk
rules.description: After a berserk unit ACTs, it splashes (self) 1 damage, then discards a berserk token. This damage can’t be increased in any way. If this effect does not damage any other characters, it deals 1 piercing damage to itself instead. Berserk counts as a positive and a negative token.

rules.name: Retaliation
rules.description: Deal 1 damage after any ability resolves that damages this unit, to whichever unit damaged them, even if this unit is slain.
